_about: One file per ingestion project. 'connection' and 'defaults' are shared; each entry under 'feeds' overrides only what differs. Adding a folder means adding a feed block - no notebook changes. Run the notebook with the feed widget set to a key under 'feeds'.

auth._note: The key itself lives in the Databricks secret scope above and is never stored here. Share each Drive folder with service_account_email, or lookups return 404.

defaults._about: Applied to every feed, then overridden per feed. Merging is recursive, so a feed can override a single nested key such as format.quote_char without repeating the rest.

destination._table_note: 'table' is the bare table name and is required per feed. Set append_filename_suffix true to get one table per file, named <table>_<filename slug>. 'table_schema' null means derive it from columns plus metadata_columns - there is no second copy of the schema to drift out of step.

dataset1.description: Dataset1.csv in a shared folder, resolved by exact name.

file_daily.description: Date-stamped daily drop, e.g. file20260926.csv. All drops accumulate in one table.

format._quote_note: This source quotes only its non-numeric field (DDD arrives as 'A'), as a QUOTE_NONNUMERIC-style export does. With the default double quote the apostrophes would be kept and DDD would store the literal 'A'.

destination._pk_note: AAA is unique within one drop but repeats across drops, and every drop now lands in this one table. enforce_primary_key_unique therefore checks each drop in isolation, not the table as a whole - a cross-drop uniqueness guarantee would need a MERGE in silver.
